none: PAS CAM-6E9313: Roman Coin : Nummus of Helena - [PAX PVBLICA].
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Helena, AD 324-341 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [PAX PVBLICA]. Reverse shows Pax standing left holding branch and sceptre. Mint is uncertain. Obverse legend reads [...] AVG. Obverse shows a female bust right. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 0.99g, diameter is 13.4mm, thickness is 1.6mm
